meta.name: distilly
meta.description: Build and use evidence-grounded local person profiles with Distilly's exact five-tool workflow. Use when a user asks to research, ingest, distill, update, correct, retrieve, or recall a real or fictional person's profile, voice, boundaries, or evidence.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 建立并调用有依据的人物档案
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常用到有条理、可复核的人物资料
copy.tagline_en: Build and retrieve evidence-based persona profiles.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with structured, verifiable person profiles.

howto.what: 相关请求出现时,它会把真实或虚构人物的资料整理成有据可查的本地档案:只用你提供的材料提炼内容并标明来源,不凭记忆编造;档案之后可再查询、更新或纠正,且不写入全局配置文件。
howto.when: 当你围绕某个真实/虚构人物提出资料处理请求,比如研究、收录、纠正等时触发。

say.text: 把这份关于王芳的聊天记录整理成人物档案,注明是私下交流。
say.note: 先确认是哪位王芳,再收录提炼。

say.text: 查一下李雷档案里关于职业的部分。
say.note: 只读取既有档案,不做联网搜索。

say.text: 赵敏的生日记错了,不是1990年,是1989年。
say.note: 按你的更正来更新该条档案。

howto.what_en: Claude turns real/fictional person info into evidence-grounded local profiles, using only provided materials and citing sources; profiles can be recalled, updated, or corrected and never go into global files.
howto.when_en: When you ask Claude to research, recall, or fix a real/fictional person's profile using supplied sources, this skill runs.

say_en.text: Turn this chat log about Wang Fang into a persona profile, marked private.
say_en.note: Resolves who Wang Fang is, then ingests and distills.

say_en.text: Pull up the part of Li Lei's profile about his career.
say_en.note: Reads existing profile only, no added web research.

say_en.text: Correct Zhao Min's profile: her birthday is 1989, not 1990.
say_en.note: Applies this fact as an evidence-bound correction.
